regime_context: The detector shows broad, non-directional thematic rotation with Gold Miners as the top eligible leader (durability 0.81, full breadth, not crowded) and Base Metals/Big Banks next. Macro backdrop is geopolitics/AI-heavy with high unscheduled share; cross-sectional rank is a focus lens only, while the validated edge is drawdown/shakeout control via the absolute-trend gate.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the prevailing eligible leadership with the strongest durability and full breadth, and it is not crowded. In a trend-discipline framework where the absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge, leaning with eligible, broad, non-crowded leadership is a risk-control stance, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so leadership can reverse abruptly; a geopolitics-heavy macro backdrop with high unscheduled news can trigger sharp mean reversion in precious metals.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by 5% over the next 20 trading days before check-by.

theses.subject: Telecom
theses.thesis: Telecom is ineligible under the absolute-trend gate and has the weakest durability among scorable themes. In the validated drawdown-control framework, staying out of ineligible, weak-durability themes is a risk discipline, not a short or reflexivity fade.
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate can be late; if the macro regime shifts toward defensive income or rates fall, Telecom can rally despite current ranking, and XCD.TO may not be a pure telecom proxy.

falsifier.text: XCD.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by 3% over the next 20 trading days before check-by.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
